_readme: Reviewer confirmations for scripts/audit-retired-urls.ts. A redirect counts as semantically supported ONLY when its exact (path, target) pair is listed here with verdict 'supported', or it is the same record (a captured rename or a book_slug_redirects alias). A queue decision records that someone pressed Redirect, not why, so it is not a confirmation. verdict: 'supported' | 'incorrect'. basis: e.g. 'same_work', 'replacement_edition', 'corrected_slug', 'approved_replacement'. confirmedBy: a role or initials, never an email. confirmedAt: YYYY-MM-DD.
